########################################
#
# Script contains analyses showing quality and length distributions
# on raw input reads from Visium V1 ONT R9 and ONT R10 and PacBio HiFi datasets
#
# Results are shown in LongAIRR Figure 2b-d
#
#
# Additionally we compute the length distribution of productive AIRR sequences
# generated from the 3 datasets above 
#
# Results are shown in LongAIRR Figure 2f,g
#
#
# **All results are saved as intermediate RDS objects and respectively used**
# **in the corresponding figure assembly script longairr_p2.Rmd**
#
########################################

--------------------2_B_C_D-------------------
-----Post-sequencing quality vs length scatter
----------------------------------------------


functions to process quality values from fastq file

parquet format as intermediate to process large fastqs

```{r}
qread_from_qual <- function(qual_string, phred_offset = 33L) {
  Qi <- utf8ToInt(qual_string) - phred_offset
  p  <- 10^(-Qi / 10)
  -10 * log10(mean(p))
}

#fastq to parquet
fastq_to_parquet_parts <- function(fastq, out_dir, chunk_reads = 3e5) {
  dir.create(out_dir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)

  con <- if (grepl("\\.gz$", fastq, ignore.case = TRUE)) gzfile(fastq, "rt") else file(fastq, "rt")
  on.exit(close(con), add = TRUE)

  part <- 1L
  lines_per_chunk <- as.integer(4L * chunk_reads)

  repeat {
    x <- readLines(con, n = lines_per_chunk)
    if (length(x) == 0L) break

    m <- (length(x) %/% 4L) * 4L
    if (m == 0L) break
    if (m < length(x)) x <- x[seq_len(m)]

    seqs  <- x[seq(2L, m, by = 4L)]
    quals <- x[seq(4L, m, by = 4L)]

    dt <- data.table(
      length = as.integer(nchar(seqs)),
      mean_q = as.numeric(vapply(quals, qread_from_qual, numeric(1)))
    )

    # NanoPlot artefact removal
    #dt <- dt[!(length < 20 & mean_q > 30)]

    arrow::write_parquet(dt, file.path(out_dir, sprintf("part-%05d.parquet", part)))
    part <- part + 1L
  }
  invisible(out_dir)
}
```

```{r}
plot_len_vs_q <- function(out_dir, sample_label,
                          sample_n = 1e5, #number of points to plot
                          x_max = 5200,   # xlimit
                          y_max = 42,     # ylimit max
                          y_min=0,        # ylimit min
                          y_label = 0.85, # label position y
                          show_y_title = TRUE, show_y_text = TRUE) {
  # reading in parquet
  qc_full <- open_dataset(out_dir, format = "parquet") %>%
    select(length, mean_q) %>%
    filter(!is.na(mean_q), length > 0) %>%
    collect()

  med_len <- median(qc_full$length)
  med_q   <- median(qc_full$mean_q)

  set.seed(1)
  qc <- if (nrow(qc_full) > sample_n) {
          dplyr::slice_sample(qc_full, n = sample_n)
        } else {
          qc_full
        }

  count_breaks <- c(1e2, 1e6)
  count_labels <- scales::label_number(scale_cut = scales::cut_short_scale(), accuracy = 1)
  
  n_reads <- nrow(qc_full)
  n_label <- scales::label_number(accuracy = 0.01, scale_cut=scales::cut_short_scale())(n_reads)
  
  label_text <- paste0(sample_label,"\nn = ", n_label, "\nMdn: ", round(med_len), " bp | Q", sprintf("%.1f", med_q))
  #label_text <- paste0(sample_label, "\n",round(med_len), " bp\n","Q", sprintf("%.1f", med_q))

  base_theme <- theme_bw(base_size = 7) +
    theme(
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
      panel.grid.major = element_line(linewidth = 0.25),
      axis.title = element_text(size = 7),
      axis.text  = element_text(size = 6),
      plot.margin = margin(0, 0, 0, 0),
      panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
      plot.background  = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA)
    )

  # central plot
  p_main <- ggplot(qc, aes(length, mean_q)) +
    geom_point_rast(alpha = 0.22, size = 0.26, color = "gray80") +
    coord_cartesian(xlim = c(0, x_max), ylim = c(y_min, y_max), expand = FALSE) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = med_len, linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.35) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = med_q, linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.35) +
    labs(x = "Read length (bp)", y = "Read quality (PHRED)") +
    geom_label(data = data.frame(x = x_max * 0.70, y = y_max * y_label, label = label_text),
      aes(x = x, y = y, label = label),
      inherit.aes = FALSE, size = 2.5, fill = "white", label.size = 0.25, label.padding = unit(0.20, "lines")) +
    scale_x_continuous(
      limits = c(0, x_max), expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0))) +
    scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, y_max), expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0))) +
    base_theme +
    theme(
      axis.title.y = element_text(size = 7),
      axis.text.y  = element_text(size = 6),
      axis.ticks.y = element_line(linewidth = 0.25),
      plot.margin  = margin(0, 0, 0, 0),
      panel.border = element_rect(linewidth = 0.2))

  # top histo
  p_top <- ggplot(qc_full, aes(length)) +
    geom_histogram(binwidth = 50, fill = "gray85", color = NA) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = med_len, linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.35) +
    scale_x_continuous(limits = c(0, x_max), expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0))) +
    scale_y_continuous(trans = "log10", breaks = count_breaks, labels = count_labels, expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.02))) +
    #labs(x = NULL, y = paste0("Count", "\n", "(log10)")) +
    labs(x = NULL, y = NULL) +
    base_theme +
    theme(
      axis.title.x = element_blank(),
      axis.text.x  = element_blank(),
      axis.ticks.x = element_blank(),
      # axis.title.y = if (show_y_title) element_text(size = 6.5) else element_blank(),
      # axis.text.y  = if (show_y_text) element_text(size = 5.5) else element_blank(),
      # axis.ticks.y = if (show_y_text) element_line(linewidth = 0.25) else element_blank(),
      axis.title.y = element_blank(),
      axis.text.y  = element_blank(),
      axis.ticks.y = element_blank(),
      plot.margin  = margin(0, 0, -1, 0),
      panel.border = element_rect(linewidth = 0.2))

  # right histo
  p_right <- ggplot(qc_full, aes(mean_q)) +
  geom_histogram(binwidth = 1, fill = "gray85", color = NA) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = med_q, linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.35) +
  coord_flip(expand = FALSE) +
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(y_min, y_max), expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0))) +
  scale_y_continuous(trans = "log10", breaks = count_breaks, labels = count_labels, expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.02))) +
  #labs(x = "Count\n(log10)", y = NULL) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = NULL) +
  base_theme +
  theme(
    axis.title.y = element_blank(),
    axis.text.y  = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks.y = element_blank(),
    axis.title.x = element_text(size = 6.5),
    axis.text.x  = element_text(size = 5.5, angle = 45, hjust = 1, vjust = 1),
    axis.ticks.x = element_line(linewidth = 0.25),
    plot.margin  = margin(0, 0, 0, -1),
    panel.border = element_rect(linewidth = 0.2))

  patchwork::wrap_plots(
    p_top, plot_spacer(),
    p_main, p_right,
    nrow = 2,
    widths = c(1, 0.15),
    heights = c(0.15, 1)) &
    theme(
      plot.margin = margin(0, 0, 0, 0),
      panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
      plot.background  = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA))
}
```

```{r}
theme_longairr_panel <- theme_bw(base_size = 7) +
  theme(
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major = element_line(linewidth = 0.25),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 7),
    axis.text  = element_text(size = 6, color = "black"),
    strip.text = element_text(size = 6.5, color = "black"),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 6.5, color = "black"),
    legend.text  = element_text(size = 6, color = "black"),
    legend.position = "bottom",

    plot.background  = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA))
```


determine sequence_id from airr table and retreive reads from fasta to get length
```{r}
lengths_with_locus <- function(constant_fasta, airr_tsv) {
  airr <- data.table::fread(airr_tsv, sep = "\t", data.table = FALSE) %>%
    transmute(sequence_id = as.character(sequence_id), locus = as.character(locus)) %>%
    filter(!is.na(sequence_id), !is.na(locus)) %>%
    distinct(sequence_id, locus)

  dna <- Biostrings::readDNAStringSet(constant_fasta)
  fasta_id <- sub("\\|.*$", "", names(dna))

  idx <- fasta_id %in% airr$sequence_id

  tibble(sequence_id = fasta_id[idx], length = as.integer(Biostrings::width(dna[idx]))) %>%
    left_join(airr, by = "sequence_id") %>%
    filter(!is.na(locus)) %>%
    group_by(sequence_id) %>%
    dplyr::slice(1) %>%
    ungroup()
}
```

```{r, warning=FALSE, fig.height=3, fig.width=2.2}
# s1_pb_bcr
constant_fa <- "~/mnt_AG_Imkeller/group_members/schuck/manuscripts/longairr/1_samples_longairr/1_longairr_revision/af5_samples/sp12_pb/seqtag/Ig/combined_Ig.fasta"

# s1_ont_bcr
constant_fa <- "~/mnt_AG_Imkeller/group_members/schuck/manuscripts/longairr/1_samples_longairr/1_longairr_revision/af5_samples/sp12_ont_sd17_af5/seqtag/Ig/combined_Ig.fasta"

                             mutate(sample = s1_ont_q17)
```
